Nga la lohsngew ba la kren laroh shlbun eh shaphang ki 
riti ki dustur ka Hima Shelia, khamtam eh ia ka sainpyrkhat 
synshar khadar kaba tang ma ka napdeng ki laiphew syiem Khatar 
Doloi kaba la lah ban kot rynieng shaduh kata ka kyrdan synshar

democracy naduh kito ki spah snem bala leit. Hadien ba nga la 
ngam la kyrthom ha ki lynter ki pynkiang jong ka laiphew snem 
kynthih, nga sa lap 1 a u ksai nangno ba nga dei ban sdang. Lehse 
ka long ka bok, ka rwiang , ka nusib jong ka jaitbynriew ba nga 
1 a kynduh ia U Rangbah B. Wollington, uba la ih bha ki jingmut 
jingpyrkhat bad uba la lum la lang la biang la ki jingtip jong 
baroh kane ka thaih ha ka por kaba biang. Une u rangbah, hadien 
ba ula pule ia ki katto katne ki jingthoh jong nga, ula pynpaw ia 
ka dohnud kaba kmen ban Varap 1 a nga ha kaba lum ia ki jingtip 
baroh jong kane ka thaih. 

Ha ki kyntien jong u ia kine ki jingshisha u pynpaw- 
"Masan, kaba lum ia kiei kiei kiba don hapoh kane ka ksing 
jingtip, nga kitram shirynieng ha kito ki Meidot-Padot jong kane 
ka thaih - kum U Shloin Duwakdar, U Jogidhon Roy Chyne, 
Duwakdar (Ki Duwakdar Saw-Seng na Shala); U Ksaniang na 
Mustoh uba la im tymmen sa ban kot 200 snem ka rta, U Along 
Sing, Headman U Sande Mustoh bad U President ba nyngkong 
ka Lai-seng, U Bising na Nongwar: Kiba ha khmat jong ki nga 
dang dei tang ban Yasong kwai bad thep duma. Nga la ju shong 
bad pynshah shkor dngong mynba ki tei ki radbah ki iathuhkhana 
shaphang kito ki por kiba la phet sha ri jingklet, bad lada kila 



shu shong syam mynthi khlem lathuh; lehse ka pateng kaba 
mynta bad kaba dang wan kin nym tip ei ei shuh shaphang k. 
sngi ba la leit; bad ngin shu shah padai ha ki leh batip jong ka 
juk mynta." 

"Kaba nga im jmgmut kliaw ban lum ban lang da kaba 
thoh ka long naduh ka snem 1923; namar dei naduh kane ka 
snem ba ka thain Ri War kala sdang ban ia lum-seng lum-dang 
kham khah-khah, khamtam eh ha kine ki saw shnong-Nongwar, 
Mustoh, Shala bad Lyngkien (Nongbah). Lyngba kine ki seng

nga loh peit loh pule 1 a ki jingthoh U Rev. Ksan (Ksan Mastar) na 
u khun jong u U Snarai Natep kumno u ruid dak ia ka jinghiar 
pateng jong ki briew ha kane ka thain. Dei kane kaba la ktik 
jingmut ia nga ban buh jingthoh bad lum jingtip shaphang kiei 
kiei baroh kiba donkam jong kane ka thain khnang ba kan long 
ka jingkyrkhu 1 a ki longdien ki ban dang wan." 

"Hynrei la katta ruh ngam ong ba baroh kaba nga la lum 
ka long kaba janai; bad ngan da sngewnguh ia uno uno na ki 
rangbah uba dang lah shuh ban ai ka jingVatei ia kynpham halor 
kine ki jingtip kiba nga la lum khnang ba ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew 
kan Yoh ia kaei kaei kaba nylla tarn." 

"Masan," u ong, "Nga la jan kot sha ka 79 snem bad nga 
tip ba ki sngi jong nga kila jan; bad nga la Yai wad lyngba ki 
snem ia u briew u ban pyndonkam ia kine ki thup jingtip, hynrei 
ngam lap: bad ngam kwah ba ka jingtrei shitom jongnga kan 
hap ha ka kti jong ka khniang bad ka sarang. Haba nga Yohi ia 
phi ba phi wad sngur da ka dohnud ban tip shaphang kiei kiei 
kiba dei la ki jong; ka dohnud jong nga ka um bad ka shad kmen 



Ill 


ba lehse ba tang ha u khulom ba nep jong phi, ka lawei kan 
dang tip shaphang la ka thymmei; lym kumta ka thain jong ngi 
kan belerong." 

Kine ki kyntien ksiar kyntien rupa kila ngam jylliew ha ka 
sohpdung ka dohnud jong nga. Hato ngan long ma u 
Nongthoh ? Ka wan ka jingkylli. La katta ruh nga durut bad dem 
diap kum u masi lur ha ka lyngkha. Ha ka snem 1964 nga la ai 
kawei ka kot sha ka Reviewing Committee bad shi copy de ha

uwei u Rangbah. Ka Reviewing Committee kala ai jingkynthoh 
ba ka kot jongnga kam don dor ha ka Literature (It has no literary 
value) bad ynda nga kylli pat ha utei u Rangbah la u la leh kumno 
bad ka kot jongnga, ka jubab ka long ba u la pynjah Va ka. Dei 
tad haduh ka snem 1980, ynda nga la Voh ia ka State Literary 
Award kaba nyngkong, ba ka bneng ka sa phngaih. Triang nga 
kut jingmut ban pyndep ia ka thong bad ban thoh lut la ki jingtip 
baroh kiba nga la lum shaphang la ka jong ka thain. 

Nga tip ba ka lynti ba nga dei ban laid ka long kaba eh 
bad ba jwat; hynrei ki symboh ksiar symboh rupa kiba u Rangbah 
Wollington ula pashat ha nga kin tyngshain kum ka sharak bad 
pynshai kdar ia ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei: ban tip 
kumno ki longshuwa ki seng riti ki sainhima. 


U Nongthoh 



Ka history kam ju klet i'alade. Ka syntuid kum ka Wahduid 
kaba dap ba shlei bad bym ju rngad da ki jingjia bad ki 
Khanatang lyngba ki thwei hamsaia ki por. Lyngba ki khriang 
jong ka, ka pathai la ki khubor tympang na kawei ka pateng 
sha kawei pat bad ka kdew lynti ia ki nonglum jingtip ban jam 
shaduh ka tyrpa jong ka jingshisha hi. Ba kumta, wat ki kpep 
jong ka mynnor kim lah shuh ban shu shong kynjah bad buhrieh 
ia lade ha ki kynthem jong ki lngaid ki lwait. Ka pateng kaba 
dang wan kan khynra kan tihthai haduh ba kan da shem ia ka 
jingshisha kaba ka dohnud ka thrang. 

Napdeng ki Hima Khasi, ka Hima Sheila ka long kawei 
kaba la pawkhmat eh; wat la ka long ka Hima kaba dang mih 
ha ki khyndiat spah snem. Ka daw ka long ba na pneh jong ka 
kala pynmih ia ki rangkynih rangphawar bad ki khun dap

tyrpeng kiba la pynphyrnai ia ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew. Ka daw 
ka long namar ba ka Hima Shelia kala long kaba nyngkong eh 
napdeng ki Hima Khasi ban ioh kjit la ka jingshai jong ka thoh 
ka pule. 

Ka por, namarkata, kala ih ba ka hima Sheila bad ki briew 
jong ka ki dei ban tip ia la ka mynnor. Ka jaitbynriew kaba 
khlem ka history ka long kaba lymbuit lymbiang, kaba khlem 
dur khlem dar bad kaba kopia ha asa. Ki riewpyrkhat ki orig ba 
ka jaitbynriew khlem ka thymmei ka history ka long ka 
jaitbynriew kaba khlem rijied. Ki thied ki thning jong ka kim 
ioh kjit jor tynrai bad ki khun jong ka ki tei paki dulan ha ka 



V 


asa. Thik kum ki ’tiew lyngksiar ba san halor ki maw, kiba tang 
shu shoh khyndiat ka sngi ki kohnguh khlieh bad samthiah 
lyngngeh namar ba ym don dewtrai ban kyrshan ia ki. 

Lyngba kane ka kot ngin pyrshang ban khura na kpep 
ka mynnor ia ki dak ksiar dak rupa ba la ruid ha ki 
mawlyngkniap jong ka: kumno ngi sdang bad nangno ngi wan. 
La ki khanatang khatar snem kynthih ki sabut bad mynjur ne 
cm bad ka jingsdang jong ka, ne, ngin shu bynshet lyngngeit 
bad mynjur lang bad ki Khanatang U Diengiei bad U 
Sohpetbneng. Ka jingwad ba sani kam ailad ia ngi ban shu shong 
lyngngeit hangne. Ka sei la ki nia ki jutang ban pynsabut jai pa 
jai; ba ngi kum ka jaitbynreiw ngi wan sha kane ka pyrthei 
kum kiwei pat ki para bynriew: bad kane ka ri ha kaba ngi im, 
ka long ka ri kaba u Ni u kong u la thied kyntang da ka dorbah 
ka snam.

Naduh Rondi haduh Kupli bad naduh Lum Meikha 
haduh Rupatylli: kane ka dei ka n jingngi. La ngi pher ka ktien 
ka thylliej, ka nam ka beit, ka shnong ne ka Ilaka; ka jaitbynriew 
dei kawei. La tip pateng ha ka history kum ka ri ki Laiphew 
Syiem bad Khatar Daloi - “Ki ju ialeh thma ban sngap ruh 
sngewtriem” kiba ki dustur ki riti, ki sainpyrkhat synshar 
khadar, ki rukom ki phukom-fla, ha ka mane shine ne ka imlang 
ka sahlang), Ki aih ki kanun, ka pyrkhat ka pyrdain, ka sain 
hima sima ne ka trei ka ktah ki iapher bak lbak kawei ka Hima 
na kawei pat. Kaba la pynlong kumne ka long ym tang namar 
ki daw jong ka history hynrei namar ka jirtglor\g ka jaka bad ka 
mariang kiba la pynkylla dur ia ki: wat la ka jaitbynriew ka 
mih na ujuh u tnum u thyndai. 



VI 


Ka Hima Shela ka kynthup ia ki 9 shnong kiba don ym 
palat ia ki 1 5000 ngut ki nongshong shnong; kynthup lang ia 
kito baroh kiba don habar jong ka hima kiba dang bat ia lade ki 
trai shnong jong ka Sheila Confedaracy kat kum ki dustur ki 
riti tynrai jong ka hima, kiba dang i'oh hok i'oh bynta ha ki kam 
shnong kam thaw. 

Ka Hima Shelia wat la ka don la ki dustur ki riti kiba 
pher na baroh ki hima Khasi ryngkat ka rukom synshar khadar 
kaba ym don jingia parpain bad kiwei pat ki hima; pynban kam 
shym pyniapher ia lade na kiwei pat ki para khun Khasi Khara 
bad kim pdiang pat ba ki dei tang ki khun ki ksiew u 7 trep. Ki 
ngeit ba ia ka jaitbynriew Khasi Khara la pynlong da ki 16 trep 
1 6 skum kiba U Blei Trai Kynrad u la mon sngewbha ban ai ha 
ki la kine ki lum ksiar lum paila ban long ka hok ka bynta bad 
ka jaka shong neh shong tynrai jong ki. Ki ngeit ruh ba ka

jingseng jong ki la ka it ka hima ka long da ka hukum blei ba 
kin iar kin roi, kin koit kin khiah krad ryngkat ka khan ka 
kamai ban paw bynriew ha pyrthei. 

Ki don la ki khanatang bad ki puriskam nangno ki wan 
bad kumno ki sdang kiba ia pher na kiwei pat ki it ki hima. Ki 
ngeit ba ki wan sha kane ka pyrthei kumba long lem kiwei pat 
ki para bynriew kiba hap ban shah ia u slap ia ka Iyer, ia ka shit 
ia ka khriat bad ban iaidwir laid sakma kumba long lem ki 
para bynriew da kaba ngam ia ki khlaw ki btap bad ryngkang 
ia ki lum ki wah haduh ba kin da shem ka jaka kaba lait phar 
na ki jingma baroh. Dei kine ki jingiashem bad jingiatakhuh 
kiba la khun wandur ia ka pyrkhat pyrdaifl bad ka histoiyjong 
ki ban iohi pongshai sha lyndet ka bor jong kiwei pat ki hima 
Khasi ha kaba ki saihdur ia la ka imlang sahlang, ka synshar ka 



Vll 


khadar ban pynpaw ha ka pyrthei ba ki long kiba iohi jngai 
bad ba dap jingmut jingpyrkhat: kiba kiwei pat ki hima khasi 
ki dang ia sdang kynjoh khaskaifi sha katei ka pyrkhat. 

Ia ka Hima Sheila la bynshet halor ka sain pyrkhat 
synshar Duwakdar jong u Jin ha ka durbar wad nongsynshar 
bishar jong ki 23 shnong ha Shyrten ha ka snem 1662; hadien 
ka Sawthyndaw U Lum Baniang bad ka Phetmungor U Mir 
Jumla. Ki 23 shnong ki kynthup ia ka Shala , Mustoh, Nongwar, 
Nongbah, Nongtrai, Dewsaw, Tynger, Lyngkhom, Umtlang, 
Nonglyngkien, Mawrap, Rymnong, Tyma, Nongkroh, Mynteng, 
Ramdait, Nongriat, Synnei, Nongshluid, Sinai Mawshynrut, 
Nongsteng Umeit, Mawphu bad ka Thieddieng: kaba kylla long 
ka Hima ba khlaifi bor tarn ha ka phang shathie jong ka Ri

Khasi. Hynrei ha ka snem 1724, ki 1 1 shnong hadien ba kim 
iahap jingmut ha ka jingthung dewanji ha ka jaka jong ki laingut 
ki Duwakdar bala iap - U Kynshe, U Stein bad u Bor, da kaba ki 
12 shnong ki aidaw ba ym dei ban thung Duwakdar katba U 
Jerkha u dang don: kala pynpait phiaw ia ka Hima Sheila. Kine 
ki 1 1 shnong ki long - Ka Tyrna, Nongkroh, Ramdait, Mynteng, 
Nongriat, Synnei, Sinai Mawshynrut, Nongshluit (kiba sah 
kyrpang khlem i'asnoh bad kano kano ka hima tad haduh ka 
snem 1860; bad hadien nangta ki rung noh kum ki shnong 
sorkar hapoh jong ka Sorkar Bilat ba la pyniaid da ki Sirdar. 
Hynrei ki laishnong-Ka Nongsteng-Umeit, Mawphu bad 
Thieddieng, ki ia syllok noh bad U Basan Swer ryngkat U Buh 
Sing naduh ka snem 1727-28. Hadien ka jingiap jong U 
Laitlyngka Syiem Nongkhlaw ha ka snem 1731; uba la thmu 
ban klun ia ka Raij 1 2 shnong 1 2 blang: ki 3 shnong kila kyrshan 
tyngeh ia (J Basan Swer bad U Buh Sing ban pynieng ia ka

Nongbah jong ki ha Weiser ha ka snem 1735. Dei tad hadien 
jong kaiVima Siat-U Dei bad ka Pom-Sohmen pyrshah a ki 
Ryngut, Laitiam bad Sohbar ba kitei ki 3 shnong ki pynbor ia U 
Basan Swer bad U Buh Sing ban kynriah jaka noh sha Sohra ha 
ka snem 1 785 da kaba ki ruh ki pyni'asnoh noh ia lade bad 
kane ka Hima. Hynrei namar ba kim don ka lew ka Hat khaii 
pateng kaba biang kim banse ban long ki buhai hat jong ka Hat 
Phali ki 1 2 shnong ka Hima Shelia. 

Hadien ba ki 1 1 shnong kila kynriah noh ia lade na ka 
Hima Sheila, Ka Hima Sheila ka sah tang 12 shnong- Ka 
Nongwar, Mustoh, Shala, Nongtrai, Nongbah, Tynger, Dewsaw, 
Lyngkhom, Umtlang, Mawrap, Nonglyngkien bad Rymnong. Sa

shisien pat ka jmgor ka wan ha ka Hima Shelia ha ka snem 
1870. Ki Nongbah, ki Mawrap bad ki Rymnong naduh ka por 
jong U Syiem Ganga Singh kila ju long kiba ia dei jingmut bha 
bad kiba la wanrah bun ki jingeh ia ka Hima Sheila, hynrei ki 9 
shnong kim ailad satia. Ki Nongbah ynda ki la iohi ia ka 
jingmyntoi jong ka Hat Phali kila pyrshang ban dawa bynta na 
ka jingioh jong ka naduh ka snem 1 850 hynrei ka durbar Hima 
kam ailad satia. Ba kumta ha ka snem 1865 kitei baroh 3 shnong 
ki mih noh na ka Hima Shelia bad ki pyrshang ban ai 
Mokotduma ia ka Hima Sheila da kaba ki dawa ba namar ba ka 
Hat Phali ka don hapoh ka Hima Nongbah; ki ruh ki dei ban 
ioh bynta lem na ka khrong ka dan. Hynrei ki bor synshar ba 
halor jong ka Sorkar Bilat kim ailad satia bad ki da sneng 
pyrshah ia ki Nongbah ba kim bit ban thaw kulmar ne pynmih 
kano kano ka jihgja kajia ha Hat Phali. 

Hadien ka jingkhlad noh jong kitei ki lai shnong, ka Hima 
Sheila ka sah sa tang 9 shnong* Nongwar, Mustoh, Shala, 



IX 


Nongtrai, Tynger, Dewsaw, Lyngkhom, Umtlang bad 
Nonglynkien: ba la tip ia ka kum ka Sheila Confederacy. Kane 
ka Hima ka don hapdeng ka lhuh bah jong ka Ri War ha baroh 
arliang jong ka Bakra Shelia, kaba long naduh mynhyndai u 
budlum jong ka khaii pateng hapdeng ka Ri Khasi ba shathie 
bad ka Ri Thor Sylhet. Ki pud sawdong jong ka ki long: shatei la 
ker da ka Hima Nongkroh, Tyrna, Mynleng bad Mawrap; 
Mihngi da ka Hima Laitkynsew, Mawlong, bad Laiseng; Shathie 
da ka Ri thor Sylhet bad Sepngi da ka Hima Mawdon, Sinai 
Mawshynrut, Fhlang Synnei, Synnei bad Rymnong. Ka long ka 
jaka kaba seisoh bad ba tap da ki khlaw ki btap barben ha kaba

ki ngap ki lwai , ki sim ki doh bad ki khriiang ki ksiah ba har 
rukom ki rwai bad kynud sngewtynnad ha ki sharing bad ranab 
lum jong ka . Ki syntiew ki skud ki phuh baroh saw samoi bad 
ki dieng ki siej, ki phlang ki kymbat ki jyrngam 12 bnai. Ka 
long ka ri jong u Knup-Mawiang. U Diengngai, U Tiewpathai 
khubor, U Tiewdohmaw bad ki spah hajar jait ki tiewdieng kiba 
niar eh ban shem haka pyrthei. Ka long ka Hima kaba pynmih 
bun eh u Mawshun ha ka por hyndai bad ka don ki par kiba 
kynrei kiba ym lah niewtang. Lehse ka lah ban pyndap mawshun 
ne dewbilat ia ka India baroh kawei lada la pyntrei ia ki. Ka 
long ka jaka ba jur slap bad ba sboh- ka ling jong u soh u pai, u 
kwai u tympew, ki har rukom ki jait soh bad ki musli musla 
kum u Sohmrit, ka sla tyrpat, u sying, u shynrai bad ki har 
rukom ki kynja kynbat dawai kiba niar ban shem ha kiwei pat 
ki bynta jong ka pyrthei. Ka ioh ka ai’om slap ba jrong eh naduh 
u May haduh u October, ka Synrai kaba lyngkot; ka Tlang kaba 
pyngngad (November, December bad January) bad ka Pyrem 
kaba syaid (February, March bad April). Ka Tlang ka long ka 



X 


aiom kaba sngewtynnad tam namar ka dei ka aiom ha kaba ki 
soh ki pai bad ki rep ki riang ki ih. Ka dei ka aiom kaba ki briew 
ki rusha kam ban lum ban lang ban kheit ban kit. Ki lyngkha ki 
risai ki dap da ki sur babang ba kynud na ka dohnud ba kmen 
ba phuhmat namar mynta ki loh ban kheit na ka umsyep bad 
na ka jingshoh jong u slap ka Iyer baroh shilyiur. 

Ka Sheila Confederary ka ioh slap na ki Iyer South East 
Monsoon kiba beh na ka Bay of Bengal naduh u April haduh u 
October. Namar ba ka shah ha ka lynti slap, kijaka kiba hapdeng 
2000 bad 3500 ft ki ioh haduh 500 inches palat u slap; katba

kito pat ki jaka kiba don hapdeng 400 bad 1500 ft ki ioh 
hapdeng 300 bad 400 inches u slap shisnem shisnem. Wat la 
u slap u jur ki briew ki long kiba koit ba khiah krad bad basmat 
basting. U slap u long ka jingkyrkhu ba ki lah ban trei ban ktah 
bad ban thung ban tep namar ki ioh la u slap khiah krad. Ki 
rashing ki ranab ki dap da ki kshaid ba rymphum bad ki wah 
ba kmen kiba mareh sted ban ia snoh bad ka Wah Bakra ban 
pyndap miar la ka baroh shilynter haduh ban da poi ha Wah 
Rupatylh. Kane ka dei ka aiom ha kaba ka Surma ka kop ia ka 
Brahma. Ka lymbub naphang lin bad nguid katba don bad 
pyndap ia ka ri thor Sylhet da ki um jong ka. Kane ruli ka dei 
ka por ha kaba ki nongjngi ba snah ki pynher la ki dieng tokta 
ban shalan sha ri thor. 

Namar ba ki wah ki dap ki shlei ha ka por Lyiur bad ba 
ki hat ki iew ki rit ki tyrkliong: ka ju long ka rukom ba ki briew 
ka Shelia Confederacy ba kin kynshew lypa ia u khaw u kba, ka 
dohkha ka dohpnat ban bam lyiur. Ka long ka por ban thaw 
kwar bad wad dohjei ia ki rangbah bad ka aiom thaw khoh 
thaw trap, thain shylliah thaih iarong ia ki kynthei. Namar kata, 



XI 


ka Hat Fhali ka long ka hat jingpyndap ia ki jmgdonkam baroh 
jong ka lyiur. Ka aiom ban sei ia ki khadki kha tyrkliong bala 
buh kynnai ha ki khra ban shoh kha-shyieng bad kylla jyntah 
ne ban kyllan muslah ia ki ksa-ksup na tynipan bad u jajew 
ban bam pura bam shngiam.

namar ba ym shym la i'asam Tapiah ia ki bri ki bsah mynba 
kitei ki tymmen ki dang im. 

Ka jingmyntoi jong ki Seng ki dang ym tang ba ki ia tip

kano kano ka jingfiiew shiliang khmat. Ki khun ki waris jong 
katei ka kpoh tymmen ki long ki trai halor ki bri ki khyndew, ki 
kamai ki kajieh la, na ka liang kmie ne liang kpa kumjuh. Tang 
ia ka Rai - ling ne ka trai Ting seng; kaba long ka hymmen san 
la ai kyrpang ia ka khyndew Rai-Ting. Kumjuh ruh ia ka Ri 
Nongsaid dei ban Toh na ka liang jong U Hymmen shynrang 
rangbah. La ngeit ba ia ka Rai-Ting bad ia U Nongsaid la

pynkyntang lypa naduh ka kpoh ka kmie, bad ki fliewsang ban

117 


la ka Rai-iing ki shaid ai ka bynta kaba bha khnang ba ka lah

kpoh haba poi ha ka eh ha ka kher. la kine la ai khnang ki jaka

Shaphang ka durbar Seng bad ka bor jong ka la mynjur

Ka Laitstep la buh thikna ha ki jingthoh jingtar ia ki jingpynbeit

Te, namar ba U Shan Ka Laitstep ki pynkha hynriew

Katkum ka rai U Sirdar Nongbah, ka paw ba ka jingbishar 
ka peit bad bniah bha haba bishar wat haba ki jong Ka Laitstep, 
Ka Steplait bad U Phai ki mut ban kyntait ne pynduh seng ia U 
Wankhmah: khamtam haba ka jingbishar U Sirdar ka shem na 
ka rai ki Saw Wahadar tymmen ka Sheila, ba U langhat Ka

Wanswett ki don 4 ngut ki khun, ym laingut kumba kitei ki ong, 
kata, i) Ka Steplait, ii) Ka Laitstep. iii) U Phai bad iv) U 
Wankhmah. Halor kane ka nongrim U Sirdar Nongbah U 
pynksan ia ka jingmudui U Niaphorsing pynshah ia U Khang 
bad kiwei kiba thmu ban pynduh hok ia U Wankhmah. Wat ha 
ka appeal ba ki shah Mudui ki appeal sha U Deputy Commis- 
sioner, U Deputy Commissioner urn shym kynriah na ka rai U 



124 


Sirdar Nongbah u ong, 

“With reference to the appeal, it appears clear that the 
suit to which it refers was adjudicated upon by the Sirdar of 
Nongbah contrary to rule 26. note (a) Khasi Hills rules lays 
down that Sirdar cannot try suits in which a native of another 
Sirdarship not resident in that jurisdiction is a party and the 
Elaka of Sheila, the Sirdar of the British village of Nongbah 
had no power to try the suit between U Niaphorsing of Nongwar 
and U Khang of Nongbah . 

It is true as engaged by U Botsing Sirdar of Nongbah 
that he took up this suit by orders of the Court of Deputy 
Commissioner, but this order which was passed on the 
7 lh November, 1872 by the Extra Assistant Commissioner was 
a mistake. 

For the reasons given the decision passed by the Sirdar 
of Nongbah must be set aside, and the respondent is warned 
that if he wishes to proceed on his suit that he must institute 
proceeding before the court of the Deputy Commissioner in 
the usual way.

Shillong, H. S. Bivar, 

The 5"‘ Sept. 1873 Deputy Commissioner. 

Ha ki jingialang Seng mynshuwa, kata, san ne hynriew 
pateng naduh ba kila shong la sah ha kane ka thain, bad haba 
ym pat don jingthoh jingtar; la mih bun ki jingartatien la kane 
ka rukom pyni'aid seng la kan trei kam ne em! Pynban katba 
nangiaid ki por ka nangi'aid donbor na kawei ka pateng sha 
kawei pat ka pateng tang da ka jingnep jingkynmaw lyngba ki 
ksah haduh ban da wandur bha da ki jingthoh jingtar. 



125 


Ka riti ban Toh bynta lang kynthei bad shynrang na ki 
hok ki kamai jong ki kmie ki kpa ka nangskhem bad nang wandur 
katba ki por ki nangTaid. Kumjuh ruh ka rukom ban buh 
jingkynmaw ia ki pateng pakit ban tip kano ka jait kano ka kur 
ka pynduh pyndam phiaw ia kino kino ki jingkulmar ha ka poikha 
poiman ban ri kyntang kano ka kur bad kano ka jait. la u sohpet 
u shynnai na ka liang ka kynthei, ki War Sheila, ki niew ba ki 
dei ki kur, hynrei kiba hiar pateng na ka liang U Shynrang ki 
dei ki ‘Jait’ katba kito pat kiba hiar pateng na ka liang kpa, ki 
dei ki kha ki man. Na ka liang shynrang phang kpa, kata, lada 
U shynrang u long na ka liang kynthei na ka hymmen, u khun 
shynrang u lah ban shongkurim ia ka khun kynthei u kni, bad 
1a kata ki ong, “uba bud kni.” Hynrei lada u dei pat u khun u 
kni, um lah ban shong kurim ia ka khun ka syngken ne kmie 
kha namar ba sang ba long kliang (shong kliang). Lada jia pat 
ba uno uno u briew u wan poikha ha ka kmienah kmiesan ha 
iing, u khun shynrang jong ki um lah ban leit poikha haka khun

kynthei ka kmie kha ne ka syngken namar ka long ‘aikhaw 
kylliang', kaba seng ba ma. 

Kumta, katba paw na ki riti synshar bishar, ia ka rukom 
pyni'aid seng pyni'aid dang la burom da baroh ki Kashari hapoh 
ka hima; wat haduh ka jingsynshar phareng ia ki jingpyni'aid 
seng la burom kyrpang. 

VI) Ka Ri Laiseng 

Ka Ri Laiseng ka long ka Ri Seng jong U Kynta, U Nabeifi 
bad U Tangrai: bad hadien ka Sawthyndaw jong ka Phetmungor, 
ka khlam kala sar ia ka Laitmawria, ka jaka shong jong ki: bad 
ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ki wan phet sha Nongwar, Mustoh, 



126 


Nongkroh bad Tyrna: bad haduh mynta, kine ki shnong ki long 
ki trai jong ka ri Laiseng. la kane ka jaka la ai sngewbha da U 
Khang U Saei na Mustoh ha kitei ki laingut ban shong ban sah 
bad ban rep ban riang namar ba ka Thylliang, ka khun ksiew 
jong ki ka ia poi kha bad U Nabeifi. U Nabeifi pat u khot bad ai 
jaka ia U Kynta bad U Tangrai ban wan shong shngaifi bad u 
ha Laitmawria, bad hangne ki roi parum pareh tacj haduh ba 
ka khlam ka sar ia ka shnong jong ki ba kiba sah ki sa phet ha 
kitei ki saw-shnong. 

Hadien ka jingphet shnong phet thaw jong ki khun ki 
ksiew kitei ki laitngut; kala don ka jingkyntur hima jong ki 
Mawlong ban dokhol ia ka ri Laiseng bad ki katto katne ki bynta 
Ri Nongkroh ha ki thain Mawthadwang. Kane kala wanrah ia 
ka thma Umsanglet. Ki Laiseng kila jop bad la pynskhem ia u

pud u sam na Umsanglet. Dei kane ka thma kaba la wanrah ia 
ka Sanglet wat haduh ka poikha poiman hapdeng ki Mawlong 
bad ki Laiseng. 

Ynda ha ka por jong ka jingsynshar ki Phareng, ki 
Mawlong sa shisien pat kila pynkhih Mokotduma na u pud 
Mawsanglet beit haduh Pasbiria. U Deputy Commissioner ula 
rai bad pynbeit ia kane ka Mokotduma da kaba thung pud da ki 
Morok bad ki thum baroh shilynter hapdeng ki Laiseng, Ki 
Mustoh bad ki Mawlong. Ha ka jingshisha ia ka Ri Laiseng la 
pyni'aid da ki member Seng jong kine ki Sawshnong, hynrei 
namar ki Mokotduma la donkam ban don U President bad ki 
Tymmen Seng kin long ki dkhot trei kam jong ka Durbar 
Laiseng. La jied nyngkong eh ia U Alongsing, Headman Mustoh, 
ban long U President Ka Laiseng; da kaba ia kut durbar ba ka 
jinglong President kan Vaid kylliang kylliang hapdeng kine ki 



127 


Saw- shnong: bad une U President un shong ha ka kam baroh 
shirta. Hadien ka jingi'ap jong U Alongsing, la thung ia U Mahari, 
Sirdar Nongkroh ban long U President uba ar da ka jingTajied 
paitbah bad un neh ha ka kam 5 snem. Mynta ka dei sa ka pali

wan sa ka pali ki Nongwar bad ha ka election jop U Sorbodhon 
Roy uncontested. Hadien U Sorbodhon Roy wan long Presi-

“ the documents filed in the case by both parties 

it appears that the Plaintiffs first attempt was that he with the

and an appeal against the Deputy Commissioner order was

Second’s attempt was in that he made a representation 
to the Deputy Commissioner on the 24 m December, 1872 de- 
signing to know what his jurisdiction was in case quarrels and

such like matters which occured in Phali Bazar i.e., whether 
he would decide and dispose of such quarrels. The Deputy 
Commissioner passed order on it to effect that as village au- 
thority he should only deal according to rule with ease which

take place among the people of Nongbah and in that other 
cases parties should bring their grievances to the notice of the 
Deputy Commissioner. The Plaintiffs third attempt was in rep- 
resenting on the 8 lh November, 1881 by petition to the Deputy 
Commissioner that he was going to levy Bazar dues only from 
the native of the plains. He requested the Deputy Commis- 
sioner to depute a constable to keep the peace. An going was

produced five withnesses to prove his claim over the land in 
dispute. 

The witnesses for plaintiff asserted that the land in dis- 
pute was allotted to himself since 6 years ago by the members 
of his family or clans and since then he has grown some 
oranges there on a portion where there is a good soil and this 
is a market called Hat Phali which was established by the people 
and which is still in existence within the land in dispute. Every 
one has the right to go to the market without paying any dues 
to any one. The land is divided into two portions separately 
by a footpath from the good soil and that there is rough ground 
when no trees can be grown. 

From the arguments of both parties before me it 
appears that the defendants have no desire to claim or disturb 
or has claimed or disturb anyone ‘s right over the upper part of 



161 


the land where the orange and jack fruit are growing but they 
hold a general right over the lower part of it. The defendants

abducted five withnesses to prove their case; who asserted 
that the land on which that Phali Bazar is held is a piece of 
rough ground situated on the bank of Bakra river and that 
nothing can be grown on it. I therefore consider it to be the 
best thing to inspect the ground when opportunity allows dur- 
ing the last winter. I requested Officiating A/r Heath who went 
down to Sheila in connection with some other matter to in- 
spect the place. Mr. Heath’s Inspection Memo is filed with the 
case from which it would appear clearly that the land in dis- 
pute is divided into two portions (parcels) that the open half 
way from the river was a jungle in which few source of orange 
and jackfruit trees grow and lower half bordering on the river 
was rough ground covered with huge builders. It was on this 
lower half the bazar was held. There were no trees on this part 
which could be damaged. Under this circumstances it appear 
quite clear that no one has disturbed the plaintiff from posses- 
sion of the upper part. It appears from the evidence produced 
by both parties that the Phali Bazar had been in existance for 
generations and no one has any exclusive right over it in any 
way. Accordingly the court dismisses the case with cost.

Judgement 

The Sirdar of Nongbah (a British Village) complained

that the people of the 12 village (Shelia Confederacy) are 
collecting revenue from the houses occupied by foreigners (ki 
dkhar) at the beach infront of his village Nongbah.

and Ka Shyrten Stream. From my visit today to the Phali Bazar 
I can appreciate the work done by this concervancy Board
